stem.text: Grain is poured into a hopper at the rate \( R(t) = 3 \sin{\left(\frac{t^{2}}{3} \right)} + 10 \) kilograms per minute, where t is measured in minutes for \( 0 \le t \le 4 \). The hopper holds 20 kilograms of grain at time \( t = 0 \). During the same time, grain drains from the bottom of the hopper at the rate \( D(t) = t + 5 \) kilograms per minute. Using a calculator, find the total number of kilograms that arrive during the time interval \( 0 \le t \le 3 \). Show the setup, and give the value correct to three decimal places.

worked_solution.text: The amount that arrives is the integral of the inflow rate over the interval, \( \int_{0}^{3} \left(3 \sin{\left(\frac{t^{2}}{3} \right)} + 10\right)\,dt \), and nothing is added for the starting amount or taken away.
With the calculator in radian mode, the integral is about 34.635 kilograms.

options.derivation: the amount present at the end reported, the starting amount added to the integral of the inflow
the rate evaluated at the endpoints and subtracted, R(b) - R(a), in place of its integral
the integral evaluated with the calculator in degree mode
